meta_data.base_class: calculate neuronal <neuronal activity> given input rate, weight, and decay rate - these metrics are fully determined by the three parameters under the same structural form.

tool_template.name: calculate_neuronal_<class>
tool_template.description: Calculate the neuronal <class> given input synaptic rate, weight, and decay rate.

input_synaptic_rate.description: The synaptic input rate, usually represented as number of inputs per second.

weight.description: The weight of the input, denoting its influence on the neuron's state.

decay_rate.description: The rate at which the neuron's potential decays in the absence of inputs for neuronal <class> calculation .

temperature.description: The temperature of the environment where the neuronal <class> calculation is taking place.

neuron_type.description: The type of neuron for which the <class> is being calculated (e.g., excitatory or inhibitory).

initial_potential.description: The initial potential of the neuron before any synaptic input is applied.

synaptic_delay.description: The delay in synaptic transmission affecting the timing of inputs considered in the neuronal <class> calculation.

time_step.description: The time step used in the calculation of the neuronal <class>, influencing the temporal resolution of the result.
